en: The First Book, Chapter on the Non-Drinker (Apāyimha-vagga)
10. The Jātaka of the Ungrateful One:
“He who, having previously performed a good deed, does not recognize the benefit he has received;”
one finds no one to perform it.
Thus ends the tenth Jātaka, the Akataññu Jātaka.
The ninth chapter, the Apāyimha Vagga.
Its summary verse (uddāna): Apāyimha, Dūbhaka, and Sattapada.
The six doors, and again the future;
for one of evil character, these are blessings;
for the virtuous, the ten are blessings through the excellence of their purpose.
